test_cases.what_happened: I pressed the ghost in the top-right corner. For a second or two nothing seemed to change, so the first time I pressed it again; by the time the screen caught up I had gone into incognito and straight back out without ever seeing it, and I had to work out from the greeting what had happened. On the second attempt I pressed once and waited. The screen changed to 'Incognito chat' at the top, a large ghost and the sentence about history, and the ghost in the corner became an X. I typed 'test' and did not send it. Then I pressed the top-right X. After a short delay the 'Incognito chat' words and the large ghost disappeared, the ordinary greeting came back, the ghost returned to the corner, and my word 'test' was still in the box.
